question: Should Telecrawl retain a read-only historical/draft artifact verifier after moving pre-publication reproducibility checks into the shared release workflow?
rationale: This is a release-integrity and operational-audit boundary: a pre-publication shared gate does not automatically replace post-publication or historical investigation, and choosing the permanent supported verification surface requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Retain an auditable read-only verifier
options.body: Preserve the existing local verifier or provide an equivalent manual shared-workflow path for historical and draft release investigations before removing the scripts.

options.title: Accept shared-workflow-only verification
options.body: Remove the historical verifier only if release owners explicitly accept that future verification is limited to the shared pre-publication workflow and document the operational consequence.

recommendation.title: Retain an auditable read-only verifier
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing local verifier or provide an equivalent manual shared-workflow path for historical and draft release investigations before removing the scripts.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current release-pipeline consolidation proposal and are the only identifiable release-path contact in the supplied evidence.
